events.title: Australian Dollar Falls Against Majors
events.description: The Australian dollar weakened against other major currencies in the European session on Friday.

events.title: French Stocks Turning In Mixed Performance In Cautious Trade
events.description: French stocks turned in a mixed performance Friday morning with investors largely making cautious moves, amid uncertainty over the outlook for the AI trade, and possibility of a rate hike by the Federal Reserve in December.

events.title: German Stocks Weighed By AI Uncertainty, Rate Hike Fears
events.description: German stocks declined Friday amid uncertainty over AI trade outlook and expectations for a December Fed rate hike. The DAX gained just 0.02%. Oil prices swung between gains and losses as Middle Eastern supply disruptions weighed on traders.

events.title: Indian Shares End Lower As Oil Prices, Yields Rebound
events.description: Indian shares ended Friday's session notably lower as Brent crude prices spiked above $96 a barrel and global bond yields jumped amid expectations that U.S. interest rates will stay higher for longer.

events.title: Gold Heads For Steep Weekly Loss Amid Fed Rate Hike Bets
events.description: Gold prices traded higher on Friday in a likely technical rebound after falling for three straight sessions to the lowest level in more than a year.

events.title: Oil Prices Hold Steady As Traders Weigh Middle East Supply Risks
events.description: Oil prices held steady on Friday after rising in the previous session as traders weighed continued disruptions to Middle Eastern oil supplies.

events.title: European Shares Edge Lower On Fed Rate Hike Concerns
events.description: European shares dipped from record highs on Friday amid uncertainty over the outlook for the AI trade and growing expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike in December.

events.title: Asian Shares Slide On Inflation Concerns, Mounting Fed Tightening Bets
events.description: Asian stocks gave up early gains to end mostly lower on Friday, with concerns about Nvidia's leadership turmoil and increased expectations for tighter Federal Reserve policy keeping investors on edge.

events.title: European Shares Seen Opening Lower As Rate Concerns Return
events.description: European stocks may open on a sluggish note on Friday as U.S. President Donald Trump's latest comments on Iran reignited geopolitical supply and inflation concerns.

events.title: Indian Shares Modestly Lower In Early Trade
events.description: Indian shares were moving lower in early trade on Friday as oil prices and U.S. Treasury yields spiked after U.S. Donald Trump downplayed the prospects of a comprehensive diplomatic solution with Iran, halted the negotiation process that Vice President Vance was advancing, and instead accepted a stalemate characterized by "no war, no talks."

events.title: Australian Market Extends Early Losses In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian stock market is extending its early losses in mid-market moves on Friday, adding to the slight losses in the previous session, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is falling below the 9,100 level, with weakness in mining, financial and technology stocks partially offset by gains in energy stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Trade Mixed
events.description: Asian markets are mixed on Friday, following the negative cues on Wall Street overnight, as a spike in crude oil prices renewed global inflation concerns after US President Donald Trump said the U.S. is no longer interested in any deal to end the war with Iran as Iran adopted a confrontationist approach. Markets in Taiwan, South Korea and Japan are surging amid a rebound in semiconductor stocks.

events.title: Indian Shares Seen Lower On Inflation Concerns
events.description: Indian shares are seen opening lower on Friday as U.S. President Donald Trump's latest comments on Iran reignited geopolitical supply and inflation concerns.
